source: proofs/lem-compcb-compressed-unit-norm (af-validated, taint clean). FULL VALIDATED CONTRACT: Compressed-unit norm estimate: there are universal C_co < infinity and e_co > 0 such that, for e=delta+epsilon <= e_co, every delta-projection T satisfies ||u_T|| <= 1+C_co*e, and every nonvanishing T satisfies abs(||u_T||-1) <= C_co*e.
